text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic photographic studio character asset, natural skin pores and fine individual hair, realistic cotton and knit detail. Pure white seamless background, bright soft frontal daylight balanced fill, low shadows, realistic 50mm lens perspective, no plastic skin, no illustration or 3D, no text or labels or logos. Preserve individual face, skin tone and age from reference. One original fictional adult man, age 23–27. East Asian man with short tousled black hair casually swept to one side, dreamy thoughtful romantic energy, midnight navy casual shirt. Original face: softly rectangular jaw with subtle chin dimple, higher cheekbones, fine gently arched brows, slightly close-set long eyes with soft double lids, slim mildly convex nose, defined cupid-bow lips with fuller upper lip. Fresh youthful light beige complexion, clean-shaven age 25, lean build. Midnight-navy long-sleeve casual shirt with open collar and sleeves rolled to forearms, light sand pleated straight trousers and dark-brown loafers. Exactly nine head-and-shoulders portraits of this ONE SAME person in a clean 3 by 3 equal panel expression grid, every face front-facing eye-level same scale and consistent face hair clothes. Row1 neutral, gentle closed-mouth smile, happy open smile; row2 surprise mouth O, worried frown, quiet sadness; row3 focused anger, skeptical raised eyebrow, playful small wink. Expressions clearly distinct but attractive and natural. Full hair and shoulders inside each cell. Square overall canvas. Narrow white gutters, no text.
